original_benchmark.notes: HealthBench Professional (OpenAI, arXiv 2604.27470): 525 real clinician conversations graded against physician-written rubric items by an LLM judge (gpt-5.4-2026-03-05, reasoning low). Original evaluation: simple-evals healthbench_eval.py (652c89d), which the dataset README calls the unofficial external implementation; the original calls a model API directly, with no agent.

harbor_adapter.notes: Oracle: Harbor 0.26.0 with the separate verifier, 523 of 525 tasks reach reward 1.0 on the first attempt; in the other two the judge marked a negative rubric item as met, and the same replies reach 1.0 in each of three more attempts (Harbor 0.25.0, earlier layout: 525 of 525). Parity on the 150-task stratified subset (--split parity), three runs per side, Harbor 0.26.0; the run ranges overlap. Parity cost about $24, all nine 150-task runs (a discarded first Harbor batch included) and both 10-task checks: $4.34 agent cost reported by Claude Code, the rest the gpt-5.4 judge (about $2 to $2.50 per 150-task run). Registry: openai/healthbench-professional (525 tasks) and openai/healthbench-professional-parity (the 150-task subset), tag v1.0 requested for both.
